title: Jem Arrowood - now
text:
Jem Arrowood. What I am doing now.

I run growth at Tallow Harbor, a company that sells a build cache to teams who have given up waiting for their own. Growth here means documentation, pricing and the first ninety seconds of the trial, in that order.

Before Tallow Harbor I spent six years doing developer-tools go-to-market at two companies you have not heard of and one you have.

I am in Austin. The company is distributed across five time zones and I have stopped pretending that is free; it costs us about a day a week and we plan around it.

I write a short letter every other Friday about what actually moved a number, including the times a number moved because of something we did not do.
